name: Charge
description: A powerful upward strike that stuns the enemy. Requires a two-handed weapon.

name: Earth Divider
description: A powerful downward strike that may reduce HP Restoration on the target. Requires a two-handed weapon.

name: Pain Dealer
description: A powerful downward strike that lowers the defense of the target. Requires a two-handed weapon.

name: Power Stomp
description: Pounds the ground, hitting surrounding enemies with a chance to stun them. Requires a two-handed weapon.

name: Guard
description: Reduces all incoming damage from enemies at the cost of attack power.

name: Rage
description: Increases striking power but makes you more vulnerable to all incoming attacks.

name: Heart Of Fury
description: Enhances combat ability at the cost of 1% of your maximum FP per strike. Damage is increased by 10% of your maximum FP. Requires a one-handed weapon.

name: Grand Rage
description: A powerful one-handed attack that recovers FP equal to 5% of the damage dealt.

name: Power Swing
description: Swings the weapon to strike surrounding enemies and push them back. Requires a two-handed weapon.

name: Heart Of Sacrifice
description: Redirects damage taken by the target player to yourself.
